⚖️ 10 Landmark Judgments That Shaped Women’s Rights in India
Some judgments do more than interpret the law—they reshape society.
From Shah Bano and Vishaka to Vineeta Sharma, Joseph Shine and X v. Union of India, these landmark decisions have strengthened the principles of equality, dignity, autonomy and justice for women.
📌 Legal awareness empowers people to understand and protect their rights.
